workout_name: Emigration Canyon Sweet Spot and Over-Unders
reasoning: We need to improve your lactate clearance and aerobic base to reduce the 9.3% power drop over longer durations. The last ride was at a low intensity, which was good for recovery, but now we need to move towards targeted sweet spot and over-under efforts. This will enhance your performance on the Alpine Loop, specifically the climb from Sundance to Cascade Springs.

suggested_sets.name: Main Set
suggested_sets.description: 4x8 min over-unders (4 min at 201-218W, 4 min at 242-256W), 2 min easy between each.

weekly_focus: This week: controlled return — rebuild aerobic base before pushing threshold again.
